title: Onboard Tertiary IT Students targeting 16 universities Globally

ms.promise:
Milestone Outputs
Aim: 
- Establish grassroots foothold across 16 different colleges/universities globally.
objectives : 
- Introduce Cardano technologies, smart contract development using Haskell/Plutus, CIP1694,Cip-1694, Midnight, HydraL2
- Upskill students on Cardano Smart Contract Development skills(of which Haskell/Plutus is very much key). 
NOTE: We will improve on the experience gained from Coxygen Global universities students(over 100) where we managed to run daily live Smart Contract Development for over 7 months as opposed to 1 day `only` events. The proposal is for qualitative onbording of students to Cardano. We anticipate getting students new to software development, to Haskell/Plutus and also new to Cardano Smart Contract development.
Therefore the milestone 1, 2, 3 and 4 outputs will be similar.

・- get at least 15 students per university on this program
・- reach at least 60 students per milestone(15 x 4 universities)
